title: Hydra: register a root agent in a hierarchical registry
summary: Initialise the Hydra registry, register a root agent, and see why a 33-byte name is rejected.
what: Hydra is an Anchor 0.32 program for a tree of agents: a registry holds root agents, which can later spawn children and share earnings. This lesson covers initialize and register_root_agent. The hosted IDL is a hand-derived subset confirmed on-chain.
app_note: The page at /dapps/hydra/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console, with this devnet program id filled in.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/hydra/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. initialize and register_root_agent campus-scout are already done.
try_steps.see: Program EKEHJMZi… . Fetch registry 7x3F2GgY… and agent 8E5gYQxr….

try_steps.do: A register_root_agent with a 33-byte name should fail.

instructions: spawn_child / earnings ixs exist in the program but are not in this IDL
innovation: A hierarchical on-chain agent tree with parent revenue share.
not_covered: spawn_child and earnings distribution were not exercised.
build: Anchor 0.32.1 program at EKEHJMZiGUex64aogXJdt7pRL66Ff46yLm2amUG6PWh8 on devnet. IDL hand-derived subset, tx-confirmed.
